# ADR 0004: Injected Clock and business-date arithmetic

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Loan amortisation and repayment service

## Context

Arrears, penalties and payoff depend on today's date.

## Decision

Inject java.time.Clock; compute business dates in Africa/Lagos; test with fixed clocks.

## Consequences

Deterministic, time-travel tests.

## Alternatives considered

LocalDate.now() calls (untestable).
